messages:
Lina: Heads-up  Launch week plan for site copy + webinar funnel. Need copy blocks (hero, feature grid, benchmarks), 3 launch posts, and HubSpot routing rules. Timeline: drafts today, ops wire tomorrow.
Carlos: For the benchmark narrative, can we lead with a single KPI: median p95 latency and cost-per-1k-tokens? Short headline for social posts.
Maya: Yes. Draft headline: 'Real workload benchmarks: p95 latency & cost per 1k tokens across Hosted, Dedicated, Private.' Keep the subhead: 'See how batching, KV cache, and quantized models change the math.'
Devon: UX ask: add a small interactive toggle in the benchmarks section to switch "batching on/off" so visitors can see delta. Marketing ops: will that impact page weight?
Lina: Good idea. Ops: progressive enhancement only; keep a static image fallback for emails.
Carlos: Launch posts plan: 1) Benchmark tease (graph snapshot), 2) Migration story (customer quote), 3) Webinar invite with CTA. Each post must link to landing with deploy_mode params: ?deploy_mode=hosted|dedicated|private.
Maya: Webinar breakout sessions: (A) Benchmarks deep-dive, (B) Migration & data controls, (C) Cost optimization & quantization. Speakers: Research, SolutionsEng, Product.
Devon: Registration flow: if user selects Dedicated or Private on form, route to Solutions AE queue and set lead_score += 20. Hosted selections route to Growth SDR and trigger onboarding drip. Also add a checkbox: "Share benchmark results with me." map to property `benchmark_opt_in`.
Lina: Copy microtests: test two CTA labels on Dedicated page: "Request reserved capacity" vs "Schedule performance demo." Also test tiny pricing hint under CTA: "From $X/hr GPU" vs "Contact for pricing."
Carlos: SEO: canonicalize per-mode pages but include a unified hub page: /inference where H1 is the shared belief. Mode pages should have H2s that match longtail queries: "dedicated GPU inference SLA", "on-prem LLM inference".
Maya: For APAC promotion, schedule a separate webinar time and localized landing copy. Add session times in hero for each region.
Devon: Snippet for hero quickstart (Hosted) to show devs it's simple: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` Keep it one-line.
Lina: Email drip subjects (benchmarks): 1) "Benchmarks revealed: latency vs cost", 2) "How batching cut token costs 30% for X workload", 3) "Invite: Live demo + migration playbook".
Carlos: Analytics: tag clicks with `utm_campaign=launch_benchmarks` and add event `bench_signup` for webinar. Map webinar attendees to a contact property `attended_benchmark_webinar`.
Maya: Design asks: hero image options: a small latency graph, an abstract infra diagram, and a customer photo. We'll A/B test hero imagery too.
Devon: HubSpot workflows: create paths that set `owner = Solutions AE` when `deploy_mode = private OR keywords contain on-prem OR company_size > 1000`. Also notify AE Slack channel #ae-ops with lead summary.
marketing-bot: Reminder: drop copy into the kickoff doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/landing-launch-week (internal). Tag #launch-week. Draft deadline 24h.
Lina: I'll compile hero + feature grid + CTA matrix and post by EOD. Thanks all. :rocket:
